description: Deletes the company's currency configuration. Returns the deleted configuration in the 200 response body. After deletion, subsequent GETs return null currency fields until a new configuration is created. Returns 404 if no configuration exists.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Integer ID of the Procore company. Obtainable from GET /rest/v1.0/companies. Identifies which company's currency configuration to act on.

schema.description: Currency configuration for a Procore company. Returned after a successful update or delete; all fields reflect the persisted record.

company_id.description: Procore company ID this configuration belongs to. Matches the {company_id} path parameter and is the foreign key to use for all company-scoped multicurrency requests.

currency_iso_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the company's base currency (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'JPY'). All company-scoped monetary amounts in Procore are denominated in this currency.

currency_display.description: How currency amounts should be rendered. 'symbol' renders with the locale currency glyph (e.g., $); 'code' renders with the ISO code (e.g., USD).

multicurrency_enabled.description: Whether multicurrency support is enabled for the company. When true, projects under this company may be configured with their own currency and exchange rates.

multicurrency_enabled_effective_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp marking when multicurrency was first enabled for the company. Null if multicurrency has never been enabled. Use to audit when multicurrency went live.

eligible_for_multicurrency.description: Whether the company satisfies the prerequisites to enable multicurrency (e.g., compatible ERP integration). When false, attempts to enable multicurrency will be rejected.

multicurrency_phase_two_flag_enabled.description: Whether the company has access to the extended multicurrency capabilities (separate base/quote currency tracking and per-record exchange rate fields used by multicurrency-aware downstream resources...
